name: Beth Aven
overview: Beth Aven is identified in Scripture as a location on the mountains of Benjamin, situated near Bethel and Ai, as noted in Joshua 7:2 and 18:12. The prophetic books of Hosea present Beth Aven as a symbol of spiritual unfaithfulness and idolatry, warning Israel against going there or swearing by the Lord in that place (Hosea 4:15). The calls to sound trumpets and the references to calves in Beth Aven (Hosea 5:8; 10:5) further emphasize its association with apostasy and the departure from true worship of God. Thus, Beth Aven serves as a cautionary reminder of the consequences of turning away from the Lord in the history of Israel.
